properties.headline: Flash Flood Watch issued September 3 at 2:06AM MDT until September 4 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Boise ID
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows caused by excessive rainfall
continue to be possible over the Second Flat, Bald Mountain, Fox,
Powder River, Tartar burn scars.

* WHERE...Portions of southwest Idaho, including the following areas,
Lower Treasure Valley and West Central Mountains and southeast
Oregon, including the following areas, Harney County and Malheur
County.

* WHEN...From this afternoon through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Heavy rainfall over the Second Flat, Bald Mountain, Fox,
Powder River, Tartar burn scar is expected up to and during the
period of the watch. Residents near the Second Flat, Bald Mountain,
Fox, Powder River, Tartar burn scar should prepare for potential
debris flow. Be sure to stay up to date with information from local
authorities. Heavy rainfall could trigger flash flooding or debris
flows in and near recent wildfire burn scars.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- National Weather Service Meteorologists are forecasting heavy
rainfall over the burn scar, which may lead to flash flooding and
debris flows.
- Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
Monument Peak, Mosquito Mountain, Warm Springs Reservoir, Coleman
Mountain, Tencent Lake, Heath Lake, Lime, Dixie, Indian Head
Mountain, Henley Basin, Buena Vista Field Station, Sheep
Mountain, Sweedes Landing, McChord Butte and Bald Butte.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued September 3 at 2:53AM MDT until September 3 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Billings MT
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Billings has issued a Red Flag
Warning...which is in effect from noon today to 9 PM MDT this
evening.

* IMPACTS: Low humidities and strong gusty winds will create
erratic fire behavior.

* AFFECTED AREA:
In Southeast MT Fire Zone...130.

* COUNTIES AFFECTED:
In Southeast MT...Rosebud...Treasure.

* WIND: Southwest 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* HUMIDITY: As low as 14 percent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS: For MTZ123 and MTZ126, the worst conditions
are expected across the lower elevations.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of strong
winds, low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can contribute
to extreme fire behavior.

NWSheadline: RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM NOON TODAY TO 9 PM MDT THIS EVENING
